title: Steve Sarkisian rips coaches for bringing back NFL players after Texas OL rejoined team after NFL minicamp stints

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steve Sarkisian rips coaches for bringing back NFL players after Texas OL rejoined team after NFL minicamp stints
sources.description: Offensive lineman Cole Hutson, who went to two NFL minicamps, rejoined the Longhorns after receiving an injunction for a fifth year of eligibility this fall.
